text:
Lincoln Financial Field buee wɔ August 2003 sɛ purpose-built football venue, na ɛreplacing Veterans Stadium wɔ kurow no South Philadelphia sports-complex district wɔ 1020 Pattison Avenue. Wɔde US$512 million bɔɔ no wɔ mfiaseɛ, na NBBJ ne Agoos Lovera Architects na wɔdesign, structural engineering yɛ Ove Arup & Partners.

Ɛfiri ne bueɛ no, ɛyɛ Philadelphia Eagles home wɔ NFL ne Temple Owls wɔ NCAA football, na ɛsan nso agye soccer fixtures. Dual role sɛ gridiron home ne occasional football ground no ama venue no identity wɔ mfeɛ bɛboro 20, na ɛde no kɔ marquee stadiums mu wɔ ne kurow mu.

Stadium no nsɛm mu chapter a ɛda no adi yɛ ne sustainability programme. 2013 renovation a ɛyɛ US$125 million baeɛ no, ɛde solar panels bɛyɛ 11,000 ne wind turbines 14 baeɛ, na wɔn nyinaa bɔ energy a ɛyɛ stadium no mu 30%. Installation no yɛɛ venue no sɛ large-scale on-site renewable power example wɔ America stadiums mu.

Ground no nso kura international football record a ɛyɛ den, na ɛde Copa America Centenario group matches ne 2015 CONCACAF Gold Cup final a Mexico dii Jamaica 3-1 wɔ July 26, 2015. Wɔ 2026 World Cup no, wɔfrɛ venue no Philadelphia Stadium na ɛde matches 6 bɛto, a Round of 16 tie wɔ July 4 ka ho — tournament chapter a ɛde stadium a wɔde yɛɛ gridiron no kɔ global game no mu, a World Cup configuration capacity yɛ 68,324.
